description: Upload files (PDFs, images, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, scanned documents, and more) to parse them into Markdown or structured JSON. Preserve document hierarchies and complex table structures for high-accuracy, high-performance OCR and document processing tasks. Parse up to 1,000 pages free each day. It also supports document image forensics to accurately determine whether an image is authentic or manipulated.
